description: Quote the WORKMINE x402 Readiness Audit without charging anything. Use this first for sellers who already have an x402 manifest and want a low-cost preflight check before marketplace registration. The audit costs $0.05 USDC on Base and checks identity, HTTPS resources, x402 v2 metadata, Base/USDC, payTo format, machine-readable discovery and origin consistency. This MCP call is free; payment occurs only when the buyer calls the returned HTTP endpoint.
